Build matrix workflow for GCC, Clang, and ARM targets with optional checks and dry runs

# Purpose
This GitHub Actions workflow defines reusable build jobs for multiple compiler families, target machines, and architectures. It accepts inputs that control GCC and Clang version selection, machine selection, exception groups, ARM builds, dry-run mode, check-only mode, and early exit on error, then uses these values to build command-line arguments for `contrib/build.sh`. The workflow runs separate jobs for `gcc`, `clang`, and ARM builds, with each job checking out the repository, installing the Rust toolchain, and preparing dependencies before starting the build. It also uses concurrency control through `cid` and the workflow context so that only one matching build run stays active at a time.
